0022600117.text: The 76ers (3-0) host the Detroit Pistons (2-0) in the fourth game of Philadelphia's 2026-27 season, with the 76ers 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East and the Pistons 1st in the Central and 1st in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the 76ers lost 0-4 in the season series, including a 116-93 loss in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026. Out for Philadelphia are Ariel Hukporti, Dominick Barlow, LeBron James and Tacko Fall, while Jabari Walker and Joel Embiid are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and for Detroit Jalen Duren is out and Ausar Thompson is day-to-day and a game-time decision.
